value.rationale: A natural inverse problem for a recently defined operator invariant is solved completely at finite spectral cardinality: exactly which geometry is identifiable from finitely many scalar radius measurements. The explicit 2n-bound recovers every distinct gap length with repetitions, while an explicit noncongruent 4-point pair proves a sharp information-theoretic failure to recover cyclic order even from the entire continuum of exponents. This is a structural classification, not a single new parameter value or a routine reformulation of the published p=2 norm formula.
